facts.en: Paid stockroom assistant at Fictional Juniper Paper Merchants from 2016-08 to 2021-12.
facts.zh: 2016-08 至 2021-12 在虚构杜松纸业商行任有薪库房助理。

facts.en: Paid finishing assistant at Fictional Bellfold Print Room from 2022-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-02 至 2026-08 在虚构钟折印务室任有薪印后加工助理。

facts.en: Completed an evening print-finishing certificate at Fictional Reedpress Centre in 2018 while employed in the stockroom.
facts.zh: 2018 年在库房任职期间，于虚构苇印中心完成夜间印后加工证书课程。

facts.en: At Bellfold, collated supplied printed sections against the approved sequence on each job ticket.
facts.zh: 在钟折印务室，依据每张工单上的获批顺序整理提供的印张。

facts.en: Counted completed booklet sets and checked covers against the job reference.
facts.zh: 清点已完成的小册子套数，并依据工单编号核对封面。

facts.en: Used a tabletop booklet stapler after internal equipment induction and referred jams to the machine lead.
facts.zh: 在内部设备入门培训后使用台式小册子订书机，并将卡纸问题转交设备负责人。

facts.en: The machine lead operated the powered cutting equipment and approved final trim settings.
facts.zh: 设备负责人操作动力裁切设备，并批准最终裁切设置。

facts.en: Packed finished bundles with the specified job label, destination and quantity.
facts.zh: 按指定工单标签、目的地及数量包装成品捆包。

facts.en: One retained 2026-01 job ticket records 120 completed booklets with 32 printed pages per booklet.
facts.zh: 一张留存的 2026-01 工单记录完成 120 本小册子，每本有 32 个印刷页面。

facts.en: Those figures describe one job’s finished booklets and page specification, not an hourly output rate.
facts.zh: 这些数字描述单张工单的成品小册子数量及页面规格，并非每小时产量。

facts.en: Trialed a cover-and-insert cross-check card with another finishing assistant in 2025-05.
facts.zh: 2025-05 与另一名印后加工助理共同试用封面与插页交叉核对卡。

facts.en: Personally wrote the insert-reference field; the colleague wrote the cover-version field.
facts.zh: 个人编写插页编号字段；同事编写封面版本字段。

facts.en: In a 2025-06 supervisor sample, 38 of 40 checked bundles had the required cross-check card attached.
facts.zh: 2025-06 的主管抽样中，40 捆受检成品有 38 捆附有所需交叉核对卡。

facts.en: Uses job tickets, hand tally counters and spreadsheet dispatch lists.
facts.zh: 使用工单、手动计数器及电子表格发货清单。

facts.en: At the earlier stockroom role, matched paper-ream labels to delivery notes and marked damaged packaging for review.
facts.zh: 在较早的库房岗位中，将成令纸包装上的标签与送货单匹配，并标记包装损坏情况供审核。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Mapletwine Zine Fair during 2023-07 and 2024-07.
facts.zh: 2023-07 及 2024-07 在虚构枫绳小志集市做志愿者。

facts.en: For that fair, helped fold a shared visitor leaflet and staffed the free-information table; no publication sales were attributed to the candidate.
facts.zh: 为该集市协助折叠共同制作的游客传单，并值守免费信息台；未将出版物销售额归于候选人。

facts.en: Hand-bound 6 personal sketch notebooks in 2024 using self-drawn covers.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用自绘封面手工装订 6 本个人素描笔记本。

facts.en: Those notebooks were gifts, not commercial print orders.
facts.zh: 这些笔记本是礼物，并非商业印刷订单。

facts.en: Enjoys creating stamps from textured cardboard.
facts.zh: 爱好使用纹理纸板制作印章。

facts.en: Passed incomplete jobs to the next shift with a written count of finished and remaining bundles.
facts.zh: 以书面记录成品及剩余捆包数量，将未完成工单交接给下一班。
